name: Harbin Fuerjia Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Harbin Fuerjia Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of skin care products in China. It operates through medical devices and functional skincare products segments. The company offers masks, toners, serums, lotions, sprays, freeze-dried products, and single-use ampoules; and face water and lotion essence and secondary use face cream cleansers products.It Iis also involved in the sale of medical device dressings and functional skincare products. It sells its products through offline and online sale channels. Harbin Fuerjia Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Harbin, China.
